heading: Tuesday Night
text: Variable clouds. Slight chance of an evening shower. Areas of valley fog. Lows from the upper 40s to mid 50s. Winds becoming light and variable.

heading: Wednesday
text: Areas of valley fog early, then partly to mostly sunny. Highs from the mid 70s to around 80. Winds variable to southwest at around 5 mph.

heading: Wednesday Night
text: Variable clouds. Patches of river valley fog, mainly east of the Greens. Lows from the mid 50s to around 60, except low to mid 60s in the broad valleys west, and around 50 in the cooler hollows east. Winds becoming light, variable to south, except south 5 to 10 mph in the Champlain and St. Lawrence valleys.
